subject: Math
prompt: District A has an area of $a$ square kilometers and a housing density of $845$ housing units per square kilometer. District B adjacent to District A has an area of $b$ square kilometers and a housing density of $425$ housing units per square kilometer. The combined number of housing units in District A and District B is $10,795$ housing units. Which equation represents this situation?
explanation: The number of housing units in a district equals density times area. District A has $845a$ housing units and District B has $425b$ housing units. The combined total is $845a + 425b = 10{,}795$.
